data.summary:
As Declare Battle Formations begins, this unit must join a **COMMAND SQUAD** unit of yours, though a **COMMAND SQUAD** unit can take only 1 Regimental Attaché unit. Then:

- this unit's models count as models of the **COMMAND SQUAD** unit it joined until the battle ends
- that unit's **Starting Strength** rises to match

If it cannot join a **COMMAND SQUAD** unit this way, it is left out of the battle and is treated as **destroyed**. While joined to another unit, it can embark in any **TRANSPORT** that the unit it joined can embark in.
